body:
## Problem
`public/llms/evolution/george-kollias.md` (hand-authored mirror, no generator covers this directory) asserts a specific snare model as confirmed fact in three separate era sections, but root ground truth explicitly hedges this fact as unverified.

**Wrong (current file content):**
- Line 51, 75, 101: states the snare as **"Pearl Free-Floating Steel 14"×6.5""** as settled fact across the post-2004 eras.

**Verified correct** — `api/drummers/index.js` George Kollias record:
```js
gear: {
  ...
  snare: 'Pearl (specific model not independently verified)',
  ...
}
```
and `packages/frontend/data/drummerEvolution.js` (lines ~5440, 5511, 5588) carries the same hedge across all three era entries that `george-kollias.md` mirrors. This is the same bug class recently fixed in `drummerEvolution.js` itself via #10775 (closed) — the fix never propagated to this hand-authored `.md` mirror.

## Fix
Edit `/home/runner/work/MetalDrummerGear/MetalDrummerGear/public/llms/evolution/george-kollias.md`:
1. Lines 51, 75, 101: replace "Pearl Free-Floating Steel 14"×6.5"" with "Pearl (specific model not independently verified)" — matching the exact hedge language used in root and in `drummerEvolution.js` post-#10775. Adjust surrounding prose grammar as needed so the sentence still reads naturally with the hedge instead of a specific spec.

## Verify
1. `grep -n "Free-Floating Steel" public/llms/evolution/george-kollias.md` → zero hits after fix.
2. `grep -n "not independently verified" public/llms/evolution/george-kollias.md` → present at all 3 (or more) locations.
3. Cross-check against `api/drummers/index.js` George Kollias record (`snare` field) and `packages/frontend/data/drummerEvolution.js` lines ~5440/5511/5588 — matches.

## Done
`george-kollias.md` no longer states a specific unverified snare model as settled fact; it matches the hedge already established in root and `drummerEvolution.js` post-#10775.
title: SEO: evolution/george-kollias.md states unverified snare model as settled fact across 3 eras — root hedges it explicitly
